world_title: Sky of Great Stars and the Trench
environment_concept: A night of great bright stars (85:1). Further on, an old, empty trench overgrown with grass, long after the events of 85:4-8: no fire and no people are shown. Last, a reading stand with a closed, covered book for the honoured Quran (85:21). The Preserved Slate (85:22) is not pictured.

unique_world.visual_theme: An old stone library in a hill town under a night sky of great stars, its roof leaking in one corner and the sun coming in at the west window

primary_mechanic.text: Carry four things (an old handwritten Quran, new paper, ink pots, a bag of reed pens) from the table to four places (high dry shaded shelf, sunny window ledge, shelf under the leak, floor by the door); each place holds one thing and must give what the thing needs (dry, out of the sun, off the floor); a wrong place is refused with its reason, and placed things can be picked up again (85:21-22, a Preserved Tablet; caring for our copies).

secondary_activities: the sky of great stars (85:1-3, read)
the people of the trench (85:4-9, read only; no one and no fire shown)
unique_world.narrative_structure: A reading on the lane, the library, then the trench account read in the garden
world_assets: four keeping places, one under a leak
environment_behaviour: each thing appears where it was put
the leak pools on the floor under its shelf
unique_world.learning_objective: Know that the Quran is in a Preserved Tablet, and look after our copies with care (85:21-22)

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: The People of the Trench
story_library.children_narration: Long ago, some believers were persecuted because of their faith. Surah Al-Buruj recalls the people of the trench and condemns the cruelty committed against believers. It reminds us of the importance of faith and justice.

world_idea.title: The Constellation of Courage
world_idea.description: A nighttime memorial-style environment using stars, architecture, and narration. Do not turn the persecution into a reenactment or violent game.

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
story_library.rule_conflicts_resolved: The people of the trench are not shown; no fire and no re-enactment.
